title: 4 Biblical Filters to Recognize God’s Voice
hook: Is that God or just me? Run it through these 4 filters.
script: You feel a nudge to quit your job tomorrow. Pause. Filter one: Scripture. God’s voice won’t contradict His Word; it cuts through motives (Hebrews 4:12). Filter two: Fruit. Would this grow the Spirit’s fruit—love, joy, peace, self-control? (Galatians 5:22–23). Filter three: Peace, not pressure. Do you sense Christ’s steady peace ruling, or frantic urgency? Let His peace be the umpire (Colossians 3:15). Filter four: Wise counsel. Bring it to trusted believers who know you (Proverbs 11:14). If it aligns, bears fruit, carries peace, and is confirmed, step. If not, wait. Jesus said, My sheep hear My voice (John 10:27).

title: Is That God or a Late‑Night Feeling?
hook: You may be overthinking this. Try these 4 tests to hear God’s voice.
script: It’s 11 PM and you want to text your ex. Before you hit send, test it. Scripture: Does this move honor God’s call to purity, peace, and wisdom? God’s Word exposes our why (Hebrews 4:12). Fruit: Will it produce love, joy, and self-control, or stir fear and jealousy? (Galatians 5:22–23). Peace: Is there a settled, Christ-given calm, or anxious pressure? Let His peace rule (Colossians 3:15). Counsel: Ask a wise, godly friend who knows your patterns (Proverbs 11:14). If it fails any test, don’t rush. Pray, wait, heal. Jesus says, My sheep hear My voice, and I know them (John 10:27).

title: Before You Say Yes: Discern the Open Door
hook: Not every open door is from God. Use these four filters before you leap.
script: Dream job doubles your pay, answer due Friday. Here’s how to discern. Scripture: Does the path align with God’s Word on integrity, generosity, and serving others? His Word separates truth from hype (Hebrews 4:12). Fruit: Will this cultivate love, joy, peace, and self-control in your home and heart? (Galatians 5:22–23). Peace: Are you being pushed by FOMO, or led by Christ’s quiet peace? Let peace rule your decision (Colossians 3:15). Counsel: Bring it to mentors and church family for perspective (Proverbs 11:14). Alignment, fruit, peace, and counsel point the way. If not, wait. The Shepherd leads. My sheep hear My voice (John 10:27).
